body.zh-Hant: 卡爾莫納1869年11月24日生於里斯本，是陸軍將領之子與孫。他1882年進入軍事學院，1890年進入陸軍學校並選擇騎兵科。其後軍階逐步晉升：1916年中校、1919年上校、1922年將軍。
body.en: Carmona was born in Lisbon on 24 November 1869, the son and grandson of army generals. He entered the Colégio Militar in 1882 and the Army School in 1890, choosing the cavalry. He rose to lieutenant-colonel in 1916, colonel in 1919 and general in 1922.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭部長祕書、校長與第一次入閣
heading.en: Staff posts, school command and first cabinet post

body.zh-Hant: 1915年他在皮門塔·德卡斯特羅政府擔任戰爭部長祕書。1918至1922年任托雷斯諾瓦斯騎兵實習學校校長。1922年晉升將軍並主持埃武拉第四軍區。1923年出任金納斯塔爾·馬沙多政府的戰爭部長；1924年任第二領土軍事法庭庭長，並在1925年4月18日叛亂案的審判中擔任公訴人。
body.en: In 1915 he was secretary to the Minister of War in the Pimenta de Castro government. He commanded the Cavalry Practical School at Torres Novas in 1918-1922. In 1922 he was promoted general and headed the 4th Military Division at Évora. In 1923 he was Minister of War in the Ginestal Machado government; in 1924 he presided over the 2nd Territorial Military Court and was prosecutor in the trials of the officers implicated in the revolt of 18 April 1925.

heading.en: The 1926 coup and the seizure of power

body.zh-Hant: 1926年5月28日軍事政變後，卡爾莫納起初沒有立即加入，後來成為勝利三人團成員之一。6月他出任外交部長，主要任務是爭取國際承認軍事獨裁政權；7月9日接掌戰爭部並兼任部長會議主席。他自7月9日起實際行使國家元首職權，11月26日以法令確認，29日以代理身分就職。
body.en: After the military coup of 28 May 1926 Carmona at first did not join, but became one of the elements of the victorious triumvirate. In June he took the Foreign Affairs portfolio, with the main task of securing international recognition of the military dictatorship; on 9 July he took the War portfolio and the presidency of the Ministry. He exercised the functions of head of state from 9 July, made official by decree on 26 November, and took office on 29 November in an interim capacity.

heading.en: Election in 1928 and the long presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1928年3月25日，他以唯一候選人身分當選總統，得到民主黨與自由共和聯盟支持，任期五年。當選後的第一屆政府立刻納入薩拉查，卡爾莫納直到1932年才把部長會議主席職位交給他。他在1935、1942與1949年連任，1947年獲元帥身分，1951年4月18日在任內去世。
body.en: On 25 March 1928 he was elected President as the sole candidate, backed by the Democratic Party and the Republican Liberal Union, for a five-year term. The first government after his election immediately included Salazar, and Carmona handed him the presidency of the Council of Ministers only in 1932. He was re-elected in 1935, 1942 and 1949, became a marshal in 1947 and died in office on 18 April 1951.

text.zh-Hant: 1914年1月，他娶了玛丽亚·多·卡莫·费雷拉·达·席尔瓦。

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、軍校與加入統一與進步委員會
heading.en: Birth, military schooling and the Committee of Union and Progress

body.zh-Hant: 伊諾努1884年9月24日生於伊茲密爾。他1903年以第一名從軍事工程學校畢業，成為砲兵少尉；1906年又以第一名從參謀學校畢業，以參謀上尉身分派往埃迪爾內第2軍。1907年他加入統一與進步委員會，1908年升為「kolağası」。
body.en: İnönü was born in İzmir on 24 September 1884. He graduated first in his class from the military engineering school in 1903 as an artillery second lieutenant, and again first from the General Staff school in 1906, being posted as a staff captain to the 2nd Army at Edirne. He joined the Committee of Union and Progress in 1907 and became a kolağası in 1908.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭、國民議會與西線指揮
heading.en: Wars, the Grand National Assembly and the Western Front

body.zh-Hant: 1909年他參與鎮壓3月31日事件的行動軍，1910至1913年參加鎮壓葉門叛亂。1920年4月23日他以埃迪爾內議員身分加入大國民議會，5月3日出任參謀總部部長；10月25日接替阿里·福阿德帕夏，掌管西線北段。1921年1月與4月的第一、第二伊諾努戰役中，他阻止了希臘軍隊向安納托利亞內陸推進。
body.en: In 1909 he served in the Action Army that suppressed the 31 March Incident, and in 1910-1913 he took part in the operations against the Yemen revolt. On 23 April 1920 he joined the Grand National Assembly as deputy for Edirne, and on 3 May became Minister of the General Staff; on 25 October he replaced Ali Fuad Pasha in command of the northern sector of the Western Front. In the First and Second Battles of İnönü in January and April 1921 he halted the Greek army's advance into inner Anatolia.

heading.zh-Hant: 外交部長、洛桑與總理任期
heading.en: Foreign minister, Lausanne and the premiership

body.zh-Hant: 1922年，他在穆達尼亞停戰談判中代表大國民議會，同年出任外交部長，並以外交部長兼土耳其代表團團長身分赴洛桑和會。1923年至1924年間，他在首屆共和國政府任總理，同時兼任人民黨代理主席。1934年姓氏法頒布後，他取得阿塔圖克所賜的伊諾努姓氏。據一份學術論文，1923年10月30日至1937年11月1日間成立的八屆政府中，他出任其中七屆的總理。
body.en: In 1922 he represented the Grand National Assembly at the Mudanya armistice talks and became Foreign Minister that year; as Foreign Minister and head of the Turkish delegation he went to the Lausanne Peace Conference. In 1923-1924 he was prime minister of the first republican government and also acting chairman of the People's Party. When the Surname Law came in 1934 he took the surname İnönü given by Atatürk. According to an academic article he was prime minister of seven of the eight governments formed between 30 October 1923 and 1 November 1937.

heading.zh-Hant: 總統、人民共和黨終身主席與晚年
heading.en: President, permanent chairman of the CHP and later years

body.zh-Hant: 阿塔圖克去世後，伊諾努1938年11月11日被大國民議會選為第二任總統。12月26日，共和人民黨臨時黨代表大會選他為不可更換的黨主席，並授予「民族領袖」稱號。他在二戰期間使土耳其置身戰禍之外，並在1950年大選後把政權交給民主黨，其後擔任主要反對黨主席直到1960年。1972年5月8日他辭去共和人民黨主席職務。
body.en: After Atatürk's death, İnönü was elected the second President by the Grand National Assembly on 11 November 1938. On 26 December the CHP's extraordinary congress elected him permanent chairman and gave him the title National Chief. He kept Turkey out of the Second World War, handed power to the Democrat Party after the 1950 elections, and led the main opposition party until 1960. On 8 May 1972 he resigned the CHP chairmanship.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、律師資格與進入政壇
heading.en: Origins, law degree and entry into politics

body.zh-Hant: 亞歷山德里1868年12月20日生於林阿雷斯的隆加維莊園。他在智利大學法學院就讀，1893年1月12日取得律師資格。他很年輕就加入自由黨，1897年首次當選眾議員，此後數十年擔任眾議員與參議員。
body.en: Alessandri was born on 20 December 1868 at the Longaví estate in Linares. He studied law at the University of Chile and qualified as a lawyer on 12 January 1893. He joined the Liberal Party while still very young and was first elected deputy in 1897, then served as deputy and senator for several decades.

citations.quote: Nació el 20 de diciembre de 1868 en la Hacienda Longaví, en Linares
ingresó a la Escuela de Derecho de la Universidad de Chile
se recibió de abogado el 12 de enero de 1893
Siendo aún muy joven ingresó al Partido Liberal
resultando electo diputado en 1897
Fue diputado y senador por varias décadas, desde 1897 hasta su muerte en 1950

heading.zh-Hant: 財政部長、內政部長與北方參議員
heading.en: Finance and Interior minister, senator for Tarapacá

body.zh-Hant: 1913年6月16日至11月17日，他在巴羅斯·盧科政府擔任財政部長。1915年他當選塔拉帕卡參議員，競選風格強調民眾動員。1918年4月22日至9月6日，他在桑富恩特斯政府出任內政部長。1920年，自由派改革者、激進黨與民主黨組成的聯盟推舉他為總統候選人。
body.en: From 16 June to 17 November 1913 he was Finance Minister under Ramón Barros Luco. In 1915 he was elected senator for Tarapacá with a decidedly popular campaign. From 22 April to 6 September 1918 he was Interior Minister under Juan Luis Sanfuentes. In 1920 a coalition of reformist Liberals, Radicals and Democrats proclaimed him its presidential candidate.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一個總統任期與1925年憲法

body.zh-Hant: 1920年12月23日他就任總統。1924年9月8日，國會因擔心軍事政變，在一日內通過先前否決的全部法案；軍事委員會仍要求解散國會，亞歷山德里選擇辭職，並於9月10日前往阿根廷。1925年3月20日他被請回完成任期，其後產生的1925年憲法把總統任期由5年延為6年。他的任期記載至1925年10月1日。
body.en: He took office as President on 23 December 1920. On 8 September 1924 Congress, fearing a military coup, passed in a single day all the bills it had previously rejected; when the Military Committee still demanded the dissolution of Congress, Alessandri chose to resign and left for Argentina on 10 September. On 20 March 1925 he was asked to return to complete his term, and the 1925 Constitution that followed lengthened the presidential term from five to six years. His term is recorded as ending on 1 October 1925.

aumentó el período presidencial de 5 a 6 años

heading.en: Exile, second presidency and later years

body.zh-Hant: 伊瓦涅斯執政期間（1927年7月21日至1931年7月26日），他流亡歐洲。他於1932年12月24日再度就任總統，任期至1938年12月24日。1944年11月8日他經補選重返參議院，並自1945年5月22日起擔任參議院議長，1950年8月24日在聖地牙哥去世。
body.en: During Ibáñez's presidency (21 July 1927 to 26 July 1931) he lived in exile in Europe. He took office as President again on 24 December 1932 and handed over power on 24 December 1938. He returned to the Senate through a by-election on 8 November 1944, became its president from 22 May 1945, and died in Santiago on 24 August 1950.

presidente a contar de esta última fecha
